name: Briar
source: Briar is one of the 3 dolls that was created by a doll maker many years ago. In fact, she was the first doll the doll maker created. Briar has pyrokinesis, allowing her to use fire to stop her enemies. Along with the other dolls, Briar rested in the house until Reuben came across the room they slept in. All she wants is to finally defeat Adelaide to prevent anyone else from dying.
